note_on_cisa_flags: The 18 published CISA ICSA flags are NOT used as a scored benchmark. They are vendor assertions about proprietary product builds and the product source is not obtainable, so a code-level judge cannot be evaluated against them: with no source to feed, the model only emits its default lean, so any such number measures nothing. The only honest metric is the held-out F1 above, on code-grounded patch pairs. Public ICS VEX flags exist in only 12 advisories / 18 CVEs total.
